_source: A10 structural closure (user 2026-10-07 'B, A, C, D 순으로'; plan and forecasts JOURNAL 2026-10-07 13:03). Collection reproduces existing comparison sets exactly (A1/A5/A8 draws.csv slots; A2/A5 sets.csv first m sites; A2 random split seed A2_rand; A2 MS sample seed A2_ms (first 12,000 of the 24,000 permutation prefix); A9 filtered arm (common threshold recomputed as in A9 pass 1, rng A9_arms first draw); A4 levels.csv + topk_l3) and checks the recomputed AUROCs against the stored ones. Constants are our choices.

factor._source: our choice: g = first principal component of the correlation matrix of the KB calibration queries' top-10-mean similarities to the left-out banks (all banks except KB, O and the comparison set's own banks; for A8 only A0 sites, excluding the twins of KB and O); standardisation and weights from the KB calibration queries only (ID), applied to ID and OOD test queries; sign: positive weight sum

length: log(1 + number of whitespace tokens) of the query title

d_peak._source: our choice (review 2026-10-07): variance-only model-implied dA_var = Phi(d_abs(1+pi)/sqrt2) - Phi(d_abs/sqrt2) per cell; per d_abs bin the ratio of means sum(dA_var)/sum(pi) vs the curve phi(d/sqrt2) d/sqrt2; cells with |pi| <= pi_min_abs dropped and counted

clip_flag: a row is at the clip if its AUROC or the abs AUROC is >= 1 - dprime_clip (as A1 at_clip); R_shape shares are reported with and without such rows
_a16_source: A16: one run on the Amazon build; a1 slot moments with the stored-AUROC check on; msunf rows via the ms_only option (A2 MS sample rule, P9 MS MARCO pool, seed key A2_ms); constants unchanged from A10. Results in results/a10 (review 2026-10-08: A1 02 and A10 02 both write meta_02.json).
